_comment: Pre-screen input: fresh macro/pre-market conditions + per-stock news, from reliable sources. NEWS GOES STALE - refresh before relying on it. To refresh: web-search current futures/VIX/yields/oil + headlines and each stock's latest news, then rewrite this file with today's date, numbers, and source links. prescreen.py and overall.py read this; they do NOT fetch news themselves. Trigger keyword: Pre-screen.

macro.futures_note: CME equity-index futures observe Juneteenth; no fresh pre-open print. Prior session (Thu Jun 18) closed strong - see prev_close.
macro.summary: Mixed-to-cautious pre-open. The prior cash session (Thu Jun 18) closed strong - S&P +1%, Nasdaq-100 +1.9%, Dow +157 to 51,650 - on tech strength and US-Iran-deal optimism, and the VIX (16.4) / VVIX (88) point to a calm options tape. But the backdrop is full of headwinds: a hawkish Fed (Chair Kevin Warsh's first meeting flagged a possible 2026 hike), the dollar (DXY 100.7) at its highest since May 2025, pump gasoline near $3.97 (up ~$1 in a month), firm crude (WTI ~$77, Brent ~$80) and a bid in gold (~$4,178) - while the CNN Fear & Greed gauge sits at 37 (Fear) and bitcoin slides post-Fed. Net read leans neutral-to-cautious; next catalysts are May PCE inflation, Q1 GDP, and MU/FDX earnings the week of Jun 22.
